name: FineWeb-2: Multilingual Pretraining Dataset
description: FineWeb-2 is a massive, high-quality multilingual web corpus developed by Hugging Face for pretraining large language models. Spanning over 1,000 languages across 1,800+ language-script pairs, it contains approximately 5 billion cleaned and deduplicated web documents (roughly 3 trillion words). Curated from Common Crawl through rigorous language identification, quality filtering, and deduplication heuristics.
